_doc: Krown layer v0 parameters. label SOURCED = the trader's number with its ledger id (KROWN_RULES.csv); OURS = judgement, chosen before any run, grid values count in the trial ledger. enabled stays false: alert-only, no live wiring.

zone_k.label: OURS
zone_k.source: bars each side of a swing; KR-L01 gives no number, grid {2,3,5}

zone_min_turns.label: SOURCED
zone_min_turns.source: KR-Z02 one touch is an event, two is a memory

zone_lookback.label: OURS
zone_lookback.source: pivots older than this many bars are not ranked (KR-Z18 'recent' is not defined)

zone_mature_tests.label: SOURCED
zone_mature_tests.source: KR-Z13 beyond three tests the break probability is higher

swing_tol.label: OURS
swing_tol.source: 'about the same' range tolerance (KR-L10 gives no number)

vol_sma.label: SOURCED
vol_sma.source: KR-V01 SMA 20 on volume (30 in the tops video, see tops_vol_sma)

vol_mult.label: SOURCED
vol_mult.source: KR-V02 two or more times the average

vol_half.label: SOURCED
vol_half.source: KR-V10 observation: volume near 50 % of average before a breakout

vol_slots.label: OURS
vol_slots.source: same-slot baseline arm: weekday slot for 1d (spec C5/C10)

vol_slot_prev.label: OURS
vol_slot_prev.source: same-slot baseline arm: previous weeks averaged

tops_vol_sma.label: SOURCED
tops_vol_sma.source: KR-V02 / TOP-05 30-day average in the tops framework

bbwp_mult.label: OURS
bbwp_mult.source: band multiplier not stated (KR-Q01); percentile formula defined in FORMULAS.md 21.5

bbwp_confirm.label: SOURCED
bbwp_confirm.source: KR-Q02 break confirmed above the 50th percentile

hammer_wick.label: OURS
hammer_wick.source: wick-to-range ratio for a big wick (KR-C03 gives none)

hammer_close_pos.label: OURS
hammer_close_pos.source: close in the top (hammer) or bottom (star) 30 % of the range (KR-C03 'closes strong')

doji_body.label: OURS
doji_body.source: body ratio for a doji (not stated)

confirm_horizon.label: SOURCED
confirm_horizon.source: KR-C03 horizon 3-5 bars (lower end); KR-C08 close beyond the pattern wick

crows_bars.label: SOURCED
crows_bars.source: KR-C11 three down bars from the high

leash_n.label: SOURCED
leash_n.source: KR-M06 three closes without touching means you are late

rsi_period.label: OURS
rsi_period.source: KR-S02 does not state the period

rsi_bull.label: SOURCED
rsi_bull.source: KR-S03 downtrend RSI stays below 60; above 60 something else emerges

macd_fast.label: OURS
macd_fast.source: MACD periods not stated (KR-P01 names the cross only)

range_width_max.label: OURS
range_width_max.source: max (top-bottom)/mid for a range; compression thresholds not stated

range_edge.label: OURS
range_edge.source: edge band share of the range; KR-R01 says edges only, no width

coil_recent.label: OURS
coil_recent.source: bars in the coil window (not stated)

coil_max.label: OURS
coil_max.source: coil score below this = compression (not stated)

s1_vol_mult.label: SOURCED
s1_vol_mult.source: KR-V02 volume >= 2x at the zone test (S1)

s2_vol_mult.label: OURS
s2_vol_mult.source: S2 volume above average (spec); 'discernible' threshold grid {1.0,1.25,1.5}

s8_recent.label: OURS
s8_recent.source: bars to look back for BBWP <= low (S8)

s8_break_n.label: OURS
s8_break_n.source: bars of range the S8 candle must break (not stated)

s7_vol_lookback.label: OURS
s7_vol_lookback.source: 'biggest volume bar' window for S7 (KR-V07 gives none)

rsi_ob.label: OURS
rsi_ob.source: KR-S06 MIXED: breakout in an uptrend usually shows RSI > 70 (H-S2, not confirmed)

rsi_os.label: OURS
rsi_os.source: KR-S06 mirror of rsi_ob for breakdowns; value not stated

rsi_ext_low.label: OURS
rsi_ext_low.source: KR-S04 RSI 10 given as one example of a downside extreme

rsi_ext_high.label: OURS
rsi_ext_high.source: KR-S04 mirror of rsi_ext_low; not stated

tell_n.label: OURS
tell_n.source: KR-T07 comparison window for flat averages and shrinking volume (not stated)

tell_flat.label: OURS
tell_flat.source: KR-T07 slow average move over tell_n bars counted as flat (not stated)

tell_spread.label: OURS
tell_spread.source: KR-T07 fast/slow gap counted as tangled (not stated)

tell_vol.label: OURS
tell_vol.source: KR-T07 recent over prior volume counted as shrinking (not stated)

grade_tight.label: OURS
grade_tight.source: KR-R04 tightness threshold undefined; width over mid

flip_window.label: OURS
flip_window.source: KR-Z10 bars after a zone break in which the first retest counts (not stated)

full_body_ratio.label: OURS
full_body_ratio.source: body/range for a full-body conviction candle (KR-C05 gives none)

tiny_range_frac.label: OURS
tiny_range_frac.source: tiny candle = range <= this share of the mean prior range (KR-V06 gives none)

low_n.label: OURS
low_n.source: drift to a low = close at the lowest close of the last n bars (KR-V08 gives none)

vol_trap_bbwp.label: OURS
vol_trap_bbwp.source: KR-Q07 volatility trap: BBWP already at or above this at the decision bar (85-93 are the trader's examples only)

vol_exhaust_bbwp.label: OURS
vol_exhaust_bbwp.source: KR-Q06 volatility profit-take flag: first bar back below this after expansion (85-93 examples only)
